items.defectStatement: The mobile `.topic-map h3` color conversion changes the light-theme primary lightness adjustment from 20% to 50%, making headings lighter than before. Its 50%/50% selection also differs from the desktop heading's 20%/80% selection.
obligations: Restore the light-theme heading color to primary scaled by 20% lightness.
Use secondary scaled by 80% lightness for the dark-theme heading.
items.notes: The actual selector is `.topic-map h3`, not `a.star h3` or `.post-info h3`; the diff's section label is misleading.

items.defectStatement: The default notification badge now combines a dark-theme background of secondary scaled by 30% lightness with unchanged secondary-colored text, including linked badges. With black secondary, this produces black text on approximately #4d4d4d, making small counts difficult to read.
obligations: Restore readable dark-theme contrast for both linked and unlinked default notification badges.
Preserve the existing light-theme background and foreground.
Preserve specialized badge variants' background and foreground overrides.
items.notes: A lighter dark-theme background is a valid local alternative to the suggested foreground change; this example produces approximately #b3b3b3 against black text. Keeping the 30% background instead requires handling both foreground declarations: merely inserting a color declaration leaves the subsequent &[href] override in effect.
